checks.name: new upload has no completed chunks
first chunk is persisted and reported
different contents for the same chunk are rejected
different account cannot read the checkpoint
invalid final chunk length is rejected before persistence
resuming only the missing chunk yields the exact original file
finished result is reusable without uploading again
lost merge result recovers by resending the last saved chunk
malformed IDs and size limits are rejected

scope: loopback isolated storage; no production API, account or database used
